connect.title: Connect YouTube to copy videos
connect.description: Sign in with Google to load your playlists and save selected videos to YouTube.

connect.description: Sign in with Google to move videos safely between playlists you own.

connect.description: Sign in with Google to gather videos and create the finished playlist on YouTube.
